subject: bella-vargas
q: Bella’s authored sentence ends in SNAPBACK, which is a Motion SIGNATURE. Pillar Three has a second Motion field — CHARACTER — and hers is unrecorded.
detail:
NOT INVENTED. The document’s own example sentence reads PLIANT PAWG BUBBLE BUTT WITH PRONOUNCED CHEEK PLUMP AND DRAMATIC SNAPBACK — Signature AND Character. Bella’s reads PLIANT BUBBLE BUTT PAWG WITH OBSCENE CHEEK PLUMP AND SNAPBACK, which stops at Signature.

SO THE SENTENCE IS EITHER INCOMPLETE OR HER CHARACTER IS NATURAL, which expresses the Signature WITHOUT ADDITIONAL STYLISTIC EMPHASIS and would correctly go unwritten in a compact profile. THAT SECOND READING IS THE LIKELIER ONE AND IT IS STILL A READING.

THE ARCHIVE WILL NOT PICK DRAMATIC BECAUSE IT SOUNDS LIKE HER. That is the exact error it made with Abbi — reading a frame off a trade — and with Gwen, reading a register off a room. A Pliant PAWG Bubble with Obscene Plump and Dramatic Snapback is a DIFFERENT ASS from the same body with Natural Character, and nobody has said which one walks around this house.

ALSO UNRECORDED FOR EVERY WOMAN INCLUDING HER: SHELF LIFT, which the Archive did not know existed until Pillar Three was read.
